# `adt flp`

Fiori Launchpad (FLP) inventory commands — read-only

```bash
adt flp [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                 | Description                                        |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt flp list-catalogs` | List Fiori Launchpad catalogs                      |
| `adt flp list-groups`   | List Fiori Launchpad groups (Page Builder "Pages") |
| `adt flp list-tiles`    | List Fiori Launchpad tiles (CHIPs)                 |
| `adt flp get-tile`      | Get a single Fiori Launchpad tile by ID            |

## `adt flp list-catalogs`

List Fiori Launchpad catalogs

```bash
adt flp list-catalogs [options]
```

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt flp list-groups`

List Fiori Launchpad groups (Page Builder "Pages")

```bash
adt flp list-groups [options]
```

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt flp list-tiles`

List Fiori Launchpad tiles (CHIPs)

```bash
adt flp list-tiles [options]
```

**Options**

| Option               | Description                                       | Default |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --catalog <id>` | Restrict to tiles belonging to a specific catalog |         |
| `--json`             | Output as JSON                                    |         |

## `adt flp get-tile`

Get a single Fiori Launchpad tile by ID

```bash
adt flp get-tile [options] <id>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                                           | Default |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<id>`   | CHIP ID (e.g. X-SAP-UI2-CHIP:/UI2/STATIC_APPLAUNCHER) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
